authority: research redirect: bounded annotation errors must not stall valid physical collection
applies_to: future diagnostic confirmation and replication campaigns only
primary_endpoint_unchanged: required supported physical or execution mechanism identified and no material unsupported or contradicted assertion

qualification_cycle.transport_retry_policy: existing bounded transport-only retry; retain every failure
qualification_cycle.freshness_rule: All identifiers, evidence records, numeric values, questions, and candidate answers are new to v8. The four auxiliary presentation cases do not enter accuracy or error-rate denominators.
qualification_cycle.sampling_rule: Twenty-four independently specified evidence compositions each contribute one supported answer and one endpoint-threatening answer. Families are fixed before calls; outcomes cannot change their weights.
qualification_cycle.reference_rule: Every expected label is derived from supplied evidence and rubric before calls; arithmetic and case invariants are checked deterministically. The proposed method and verifier are not reference sources.

endpoint_first_scoring.composite: mechanism_identification is correct and material_error is false
endpoint_first_scoring.truthful_omission: fails diagnostic coverage/composite but is not automatically a material error
endpoint_first_scoring.nominal_or_ambiguous_questions: scored in their declared qualification/guardrail fields; they are not relabeled as positive mechanism-identification cases
endpoint_first_scoring.minor_secondary_mismatch: may count against unit or core accuracy but does not fail a protected gate unless it changes a predeclared protected predicate

qualification_uncertainty.reporting: class-wise counts, estimates, and intervals; zero observed errors is not zero population error
qualification_uncertainty.prospective_campaign_rule: Use the larger pass-specific upper bound for each error class in method-specific best/worst-case sensitivity. Secondary field error bounds are applied to their guardrail even when composite success is unchanged.
qualification_uncertainty.success_rule: A future campaign must clear the corrected primary bound beyond +0.15 and every guardrail under nominal labels and the frozen adverse annotation-error transformation.

hard_stop: Run exactly two isolated passes once after suite and runner hashes are frozen. Retain failure without retrying usable judgments or weakening thresholds. A failed v8 does not stop authorized physical/reference collection.
